pages.text: Melt one Ice and Fire sapphire into 100 mB of molten sapphire. Alloy 100 mB each of molten emerald, molten diamond and molten sapphire at 1450°C to yield 100 mB of crystal essence.

Pour 100 mB of crystal essence over one Ice and Fire dragon bone on a casting table to make one crystallized dragonbone. Each bone is one unit of tier 4 Part Builder material for heads, handles, bindings, bow limbs and grips. Each part grants one level of $(l:trait_crystal_catalyst)Catalyst$().
Head: 750 durability, diamond harvest tier, 5 mining speed and 7.5 melee damage. Handle: +20% durability, +15% damage, −8% attack speed and unchanged mining speed. Bindings have no extra stats.
Limb: 750 durability, −0.2 draw speed, +1.5 velocity and −0.1 accuracy. Grip: +20% durability, −0.1 accuracy and 5.5 melee damage.
